label: Rwanda
searches: Rwanda Mines Petroleum Gas Board sand
focusedSearches: Rwanda sand mining peer reviewed research
scope: Only include sources substantively about sand extraction or mining from rivers, riverbeds, riverbanks, lakeshores or wetlands in Rwanda, or its licensing, cooperatives, enforcement, livelihoods, construction demand and environmental effects. Exclude 3T and gold mining (cassiterite, coltan, wolfram, gold) unless the source concerns construction-sand extraction; stone quarries with no river or wetland link; and Lake Kivu methane.
basinRule: Assign rw-congo to Lake Kivu, the Rusizi and their tributaries (Sebeya, Koko, Kiwi; Rubavu, Rutsiro, Karongi, Nyamasheke, Rusizi districts); assign rw-nile to the Nyabarongo, Akanyaru, Akagera, Mukungwa, Base, Muvumba and other rivers draining east (Kigali, Southern, Eastern and most of Northern Province); rw-national only for Rwanda-wide material. For districts on the Congo–Nile divide (e.g. Nyabihu, Ngororero, Nyamagabe, Nyaruguru), choose by the named river and state the assumption in limitations.
languageNote: Translate a Kinyarwanda or French headline into clear English, preserving the exact source headline in originalTitle.
unitsNote: tonnes, cubic metres, truckloads, RWF with time basis
